From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>

Cc: Tom Jacobs <tom.j@heliohealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR — stakeholder slices & delegate calendar ping

Hi Heather —

Hope you’re well. We’re starting to lock in the renewal QBR + roadmap demo for HelioHealth and want to propose a compact schedule that respects your execs’ time while keeping the engineering deep-dive available for the technical leads. Two options we can run as a "stakeholder slice":

- Option A (single block): 90 minutes total — 60-minute roadmap/demo (exec + product highlights) + 30-minute technical breakout for engineers.
- Option B (split): 60-minute exec session + separate 45-minute technical clinic later that week (recording + notes for execs).

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue May 26 — 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu May 27 — 11:00–12:30 or 15:00–16:30

Requests from our side:
1) Which option (A/B) do you prefer?
2) Who will be the primary delegate(s) for the technical breakout (name + role) so we can invite them directly?
3) Any hard blocks for the execs on the proposed windows above?

I attached a draft agenda and a mutual action plan that maps owners/time for pre-reads and post-demo deliverables. If it’s easier, we can also send a short calendar ping to the delegates and Ops contacts to lock a single provisional slot and then confirm.

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
Attachments: QBR-Agenda-v3.pdf (draft, 2 pages), MutualActionPlan_HelioHealth.xlsx (MOP)

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the options and the agenda — looks sensible. A couple of constraints from our side:
- Execs are tight that week; they prefer a single, time-boxed session if possible (so Option A).
- Best window for exec availability is Thu May 27, roughly 2:00–3:30 ET (which I think maps to 11:00–12:30 PT).
- Our lead architect (will likely cover the technical breakout) is out on Tue the 26th morning.

Delegates:
- Tom Jacobs (Head of Data Platform) — will join both exec + tech segments.
- I’ll assign Lina Park as the backup for product questions (Lina.Park@heliohealth.com) — she can take notes.

Two asks before we lock: please include a 5–7 minute slide on data handling/audit trail for the roadmap section (execs want to see retention/audit bullet points). Also can you add procurement to the calendar invite once dates are nailed (procurement@heliohealth.com)?

If you can send a provisional invite for Thu 27 11:00 PT, I’ll confirm with execs, otherwise I can send a counter-proposal.

—Heather
Heather Lane
VP, Strategic Partnerships | HelioHealth
